cases.case: Correct numbers alone, but no explanation/correction of misleading chart and no clearer alternative.

cases.basis: Original permits proposing a clearer representation; the task explicitly allows a table.

cases.case: One percent arithmetic slip but correct truncated-baseline explanation and unchanged-data alternative.

cases.case: No substitution check anywhere, despite correct domain and numerical roots.
